sourceTitle: Margaret of Anjou Makers of History
description: "Margaret of Anjou" by Jacob Abbott is a historical account written in the early 20th century. The narrative centers on Margaret of Anjou, a significant historical figure who was the queen of Henry VI of England, and explores the tumultuous events during her life amid the wars of the houses of York and Lancaster.
